endings.title: The City Knows
endings.summary: The evidence is released through trusted journalists. Vale's network is exposed, but the city must rebuild its institutions.

endings.title: A Quiet Horizon
endings.summary: Alex helps Leo disappear safely. The network is damaged but not fully dismantled; the family gets a chance to start again.

endings.title: No One Left Behind
endings.summary: The whole crew coordinates a protected release and witness evacuation. The truth survives because the team trusts one another.

endings.title: The Necessary Lie
endings.summary: A deal keeps the witnesses safe and buys time. Vale loses leverage, but the public never learns the whole story.

endings.title: Static
endings.summary: Evidence is incomplete and trust has fractured. Leo is found, but Vale's organisation remains powerful and the group goes separate ways.
